nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field and let $n_1, \dots, n_r$ be natural numbers with $n_1 + \dots + n_r > 0$. Then the multihomogeneous component of multidegree $(n_1, \dots, n_r)$ of the free Lie algebra over $K$ on $r$ generators has dimension over $K$ equal to Witt's multigraded value $M(n_1, \dots, n_r)$.
nodes.title: Dimension of a multihomogeneous component of a free Lie algebra

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $r$ a natural number, and $L$ the free Lie algebra over $K$ on generators $x_0, \dots, x_{r-1}$. For a multidegree $d \in \mathbb{N}^r$, the multihomogeneous component of $L$ of multidegree $d$ is the $K$-linear span of the homogeneous Lie monomials of multidegree $d$, that is, of the iterated brackets of the generators in which each $x_i$ occurs exactly $d_i$ times.
